content: MK reports that in the R. al-Inzaliyya, written sometime before 828/1425, Ibn Turka decries the current unpopularity of lettrism in Iran, likening his local contemporaries' simplemindedness to suckling babies' rejection of solid food.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. al-Inzaliyya, ed. Bihbahani, 144; cf. 138
